name: KY-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Challenger Rodriquez has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: The district's +10 Democratic lean, McGarvey's incumbency and large financial advantage over an underfunded challenger, and prediction markets pricing him near 97% all point to a comfortable hold. With no polls or expert ratings available, uncertainty stays elevated but the favorite is clear.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a tighter race or unexpected outside spending against McGarvey would be the first sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Morgan McGarvey, the Democratic incumbent, seeks reelection in a Louisville-area district that leans about ten points Democratic. He enters the race with roughly $1.8 million on hand after raising over $1.6 million, while Republican challenger Maria Rodriquez has reported no fundraising figures. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the picture rests on fundamentals and market pricing.

Prediction markets put McGarvey's chances near 97 percent, consistent with the district's lean and his financial edge. The forecast expects a decisive incumbent win, with some added uncertainty because direct polling evidence is absent.
